Before we begin

### Common questions about Power BI and dashboard consulting

Not answered here? Ask us directly or read the full FAQ.

**Can you work with our existing Power BI model instead of rebuilding it?**
Usually yes, and that is where we prefer to start. A review covers grain, relationships, calculated columns, duplicated measures, storage mode and refresh behavior, and produces a written list of what to fix in place and what genuinely needs rebuilding. A rebuild is something we have to justify, not a starting assumption.

**What is a semantic model and why does it matter?**
It is the layer between your warehouse and your dashboards that holds tables, relationships and agreed measures. When it exists, every report calculates revenue the same way. When it does not, each dashboard re-implements the logic and the numbers drift apart. It also lets analysts build their own views without writing joins.

**Our dashboards disagree with each other. Where does that get fixed?**
Almost always upstream of the dashboard. The usual causes are different filters, a different grain, different date logic or a metric defined twice. We trace each figure back to its source, agree one definition per metric with a named owner, and move the calculation into the model so a report is no longer the place the logic lives.

**Which BI tool should we use?**
Start with the tools your analysts use and the job the report needs to do. We build Power BI semantic models, Tableau workbooks, Looker Studio dashboards and custom applications in Streamlit. If an existing dashboard can answer the question with a better measure or filter, we can start there.

**Do we need a data warehouse before we can do BI properly?**
Not always, but usually. A semantic model can read an operational database for a while and sometimes that is the right call. Once reports need history, several sources, or a grain the source system does not store, a curated warehouse layer costs less than repeatedly patching reports. We can tell you which situation you are in after looking at the sources.

**Our dashboard refresh is too slow or times out. What can be done?**
The fix is to reduce what the report has to read rather than importing less data as a workaround. That means partitioning, incremental refresh, aggregation tables, pushing transformation back into the warehouse and removing columns nothing uses. On past work this has reduced query scan sizes by 60 to 75% and moved refreshes from hours to minutes.

**How much does a Power BI consultant cost?**
We quote after a scoping call. A useful first project is one dashboard rebuilt on an agreed grain and reconciled against the figures people already trust, and further dashboards and a wider semantic layer are scoped once that first one is agreed. Our team works from New York and Ahmedabad, India, with working hours planned around your time zone and a lean model that avoids large-consultancy overhead.

**Can you help us replace a Tableau or Power BI dashboard with a custom workspace?**
Yes. The Business Intelligence Platform demo shows how people can ask an AI assistant for a figure and follow it back to its source. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) gives the assistant read-only access to reports the signed-in person can open. We would start with one Tableau workbook or Power BI report, compare figures for the same dates and filters, and test each user role. Your team can run both versions side by side and decide which dashboards to move next.

### Common questions about data engineering consulting

Before we begin

### Questions about migrating to Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift

Not answered here? Ask us directly or read the full FAQ.

**How long does a data warehouse migration take?**
It depends far more on dependencies than on data volume. Discovery and dependency analysis on a mid-sized estate typically takes weeks; the migration is then scoped domain by domain, each reconciled before the next begins. We would rather give an estimate after discovery than before it, and discovery can be bought as a standalone piece of work.

**Do you migrate ETL pipelines as well as the data?**
Yes. An ETL migration moves the jobs that load and transform the data, not just the tables. We inventory the existing pipelines, stored procedures and scheduled jobs, rebuild them for the new platform as tested, version-controlled code, and run old and new side by side until the outputs reconcile.

**What do ETL migration engineering services include?**
An inventory of the existing jobs and what depends on them, a mapping from each source table and transformation to the new platform, rebuilt or converted pipelines, historical loads, parallel runs with reconciliation, cutover and documentation. The old jobs are retired once report owners have signed off.

**How do you migrate a data warehouse to Snowflake?**
We inventory the tables, jobs and reports, map data types and SQL dialect differences, load history through staged files and rebuild the transformations as SQL models. Old and new run side by side, and each report switches when its totals match and its owner signs off. Warehouse sizing, roles and cost monitoring are set up before the cutover.

**How do you migrate a data warehouse to BigQuery?**
The steps are the same, with BigQuery specifics. We design datasets, partitioning and clustering around how the tables are queried, convert SQL to GoogleSQL, load history through Cloud Storage or the BigQuery Data Transfer Service and set cost controls such as query quotas. Each report is checked against the old warehouse before it switches.

**How do you prove the new warehouse is correct?**
By comparing it with the old one, automatically and repeatedly. Record counts and control totals per load, date coverage and gap checks, null and duplicate profiles, key uniqueness, and metric-level comparison of reported figures. Every difference is investigated and then either fixed or documented as a deliberate change, including the cases where the legacy number turns out to be the wrong one.

**Can we migrate without breaking existing dashboards?**
That is what the dependency analysis is for. Before anything moves we trace which reports, extracts and semantic models read which objects, and flag the business logic hiding inside them. Dashboards are then repointed and reconciled visual by visual, usually while both platforms run in parallel, so the old estate is switched off only after the new numbers have been signed off.

**Should we lift and shift, or redesign?**
Usually a mix, decided per domain. Lifting and shifting is faster and keeps reconciliation simple, but it carries forward the modeling problems and often the cost profile. Redesigning is right where the grain is wrong, where legacy logic is unmaintainable, or where query patterns will change on the new platform. Discovery is what tells you which objects belong in which category.

**Our reporting lives in spreadsheets rather than a database. Is that still a migration?**
Yes, and it is a common one. The shape of the work is the same: find the sources behind the spreadsheets, document the rules that live in formulas and in people’s heads, model them in the warehouse and reconcile the output against the last few months of manual figures. The difference is that more of the discovery happens in conversation than in the information schema.

**How much does a data warehouse migration cost?**
We quote after a scoping call, because the effort depends on what discovery finds in your estate. Discovery can be bought as a standalone piece of work, and migrating one reporting domain first gives an estimate for the rest of the estate based on your data rather than on a template. Commercial terms are agreed per engagement.

**Can a remote team in India run our warehouse migration?**
Yes. MV.tech Solutions is headquartered in New York, USA, with an office in Ahmedabad, India. Our data engineering team agrees working hours with you. The migration runs on written work both sides can review: a source-to-target mapping that both sides sign off, automated reconciliation results at every stage, and written sign-off per domain before legacy objects are retired. Handover includes the mappings, ER diagrams, validation results, schedules, ownership and operating runbooks.

### How to assess someone who will own a pipeline

Explore our expertiseTime zones, team and engagement costsOutsourcing by region
Before we begin

### Common questions about MCP server development and AI connectors

Not answered here? Ask us directly or read the full FAQ.

**What is an MCP server, in practice?**
It is a small service that describes a set of tools and resources in a standard way, so any compatible AI application can use them without a bespoke integration. In practice it is ordinary backend engineering: authenticate, validate the input, call the underlying system, shape the response, log the call. The protocol is the straightforward part; the access model is the work.

**How is this different from your AI automation and RAG service?**
The AI automation, RAG and MCP development page covers the assistant itself: knowledge sources, retrieval, model behavior and the user-facing workflow. This page covers the layer underneath it — the servers and connectors that give agents governed access to live systems. Many projects need both and they are often scoped together. If you are not sure which one you are asking for, describe the workflow and we will say.

**Can an agent be allowed to write data, not just read it?**
It can, with deliberate design. Write tools are kept separate from read tools, restricted to specific objects and operations, made idempotent where possible, and in most cases placed behind a human approval step that happens outside the model’s control. We would start read-only, prove tool selection is reliable, then add write capability one operation at a time.

**Which AI platforms can use what you build?**
Any MCP-compatible client, which now covers the major assistant and IDE products, plus platform-specific connectors and plugins where an organization has standardized on one vendor. We test against the clients you actually use, because a tool description that works well in one client can be read differently in another.

**How do you stop prompt injection turning a tool into a problem?**
By not relying on the model to enforce anything. Permissions are checked server-side before a tool runs, tools expose only approved objects, generated SQL is validated against a whitelist, destructive operations are either not exposed or require human approval, and retrieved content is treated as data rather than as instructions. Logging every call means an unexpected request is visible afterwards, not merely prevented in theory.

**How much does custom MCP server development cost?**
We quote after a scoping call, and terms are agreed per engagement. The recommended starting point is small: one server, one system, one small group of users and the three or four tools that cover most of their requests. Our team works from New York and Ahmedabad, India, with a lean model that avoids large-consultancy overhead.

**How do you connect Claude or another AI assistant to our database safely?**
Instead of handing the assistant the keys, it calls an MCP server that runs under a scoped service identity against an approved set of tables, read-only by default and whitelisted rather than blocklisted. Where the agent generates SQL, the query is parsed and checked before it runs, with permitted objects only, row and cost limits and no writes, and results are validated before they are returned. Every call is logged with the caller, tool, time and outcome, and we test against real requests, including ones the server should refuse, before access is widened.

Before we begin

### Questions about hiring a Power BI consultant.

Not answered here? Ask us directly or read the full FAQ.

**Why is my Power BI dashboard refresh slow?**
Usually because the model imports more than it reads, or does work at refresh time that belongs in the warehouse. The common causes are calculated columns over large fact tables, high-cardinality columns such as timestamps or free text, Power Query steps that stop folding so a whole table is pulled before it is filtered, and a full refresh where an incremental policy would do. We profile the model with DAX Studio and the refresh history first, then change the few things that account for most of the time.

**What is a Power BI semantic model?**
It is the dataset layer between your warehouse and your reports: tables, relationships, measures, hierarchies and security roles. When it exists as one governed model, every report calculates revenue the same way and analysts can build their own views without writing joins. When each report carries its own copy of the data and its own measures, the numbers drift apart.

**Can you fix our existing Power BI model instead of rebuilding it?**
Usually, and that is the cheaper place to start. The review covers grain, relationships, calculated columns, duplicated measures, storage mode and refresh behavior, and ends in a written list of what to fix in place and what genuinely needs remodelling. A rebuild is something we have to justify, not a starting assumption.

**Can you migrate our SSAS or Azure Analysis Services model to Power BI?**
Yes. The first step is documenting what the tabular model contains and which reports depend on each table and measure, because that decides whether it can move largely as-is through the XMLA endpoint or should be remodelled. Measures are compared old against new on identical filters before any report is repointed, and both models run in parallel until the figures are signed off.

**How much does Power BI consulting cost?**
We quote after a scoping call. The estimate depends on the number of reports and sources, the state of the existing model, whether an Analysis Services migration is involved and how much reconciliation the business needs to see. A review of one existing model is a bounded piece of work and is usually the cheapest way to find out what the rest would involve.

**Can a remote team in India work on our Power BI tenant?**
Yes. MV.tech Solutions works from India Standard Time and agrees an overlap window with your team before the engagement begins, with access through your own tenant, workspaces and gateway rather than through copies of your data. Changes go through deployment pipelines or version-controlled model files, so your team can see what changed and when.

**How do you prove the numbers on a report are right?**
By reconciling them to source and keeping the check running. Record counts, control totals and date coverage per table, plus the handful of figures people actually act on, are compared against the source system on every refresh. Differences are investigated and either fixed or written down as a deliberate change, which sometimes means the old report was the one that was wrong.

**Can we build a custom BI workspace around a report the team already trusts?**
Yes. Bring one Power BI report, its key measures and a question colleagues often send to an analyst. The Business Intelligence Platform example shows how the Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets an AI assistant read the reports each person can open. For your build, we would compare answers with your existing report for the same dates and filters, then test what each role can see.

Explore our expertiseTime zones, team and engagement costsOutsourcing by region
Before we begin

### Questions about Snowflake consulting.

Not answered here? Ask us directly or read the full FAQ.

**Is MV.tech Solutions a Snowflake consulting partner?**
No. MV.tech Solutions is not a Snowflake reseller or a member of the Snowflake partner program; it works as an independent engineering team that designs, migrates and tunes Snowflake warehouses on your own Snowflake account. You buy Snowflake from Snowflake and engineering from us, so there is no resale margin in the advice. The founder holds the Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer certification; MV.tech Solutions makes no Snowflake certification or partner claims.

**How much does Snowflake consulting cost?**
For Snowflake work, we quote after a scoping call. The estimate depends on the number of source systems, the volume of historical data, how much logic is hidden in views, stored procedures and spreadsheets, the Power BI models to be repointed and the support expected afterwards. A first domain is scoped as a bounded piece of work so the figure for the rest of the estate rests on your data rather than on a template.

**How do you migrate SQL Server or Oracle to Snowflake without breaking reports?**
Dependency analysis first, reconciliation throughout. Before anything moves we trace which reports, extracts and semantic models read each object and flag the platform-specific SQL, cross-database joins and hardcoded rules that will not survive the move. Layers are then built and compared with the legacy numbers stage by stage, and dashboards are repointed visual by visual, usually while both platforms run in parallel.

**Should Power BI connect to Snowflake with Import or DirectQuery?**
Import for most governed reporting, DirectQuery where data must be current to the minute or is too large to hold in memory, and a composite model when one report needs both. The more important decision is upstream: Power BI should read fact and dimension tables and curated views from the reporting layer, not raw tables, so the model stays small and the business logic lives in one place. We profile the existing model before recommending a change.

**Why is our Snowflake bill rising, and can you reduce it?**
Usually because warehouses stay awake for queries that scan more than they should. The common causes are missing clustering on large tables, full refreshes where incremental loads would do, oversized warehouses with long auto-suspend settings and reports that repeat the same aggregate many times an hour. We measure from the query history, change the few things that account for most of the spend and show the before-and-after on your own credit consumption.

**Can a remote team in India run our Snowflake migration?**
Yes. Our team works from New York and Ahmedabad, India, and agrees a collaboration window in your time zone before work begins: US Eastern mornings, UK and European business hours, Gulf hours or Asia-Pacific afternoons. Snowflake work suits remote delivery because access is role-based and every change can be reviewed as SQL in a pull request. Reconciliation results, decisions and handover notes are written down where your team can read them the next morning.

**Can you reconcile Snowflake with Salesforce CRM Analytics and our finance system?**
Yes, and it is often the part that earns trust in the warehouse. We compare the same metric across the source systems, Snowflake and the CRM Analytics or BI layer at an agreed grain, then investigate every difference until it is fixed or documented as a deliberate change. That investigation sometimes shows that the legacy figure was the wrong one.

### Questions about web development

MV.tech Solutions services

## Workflow automation and business system integration.

Reduce the manual work between your business systems. MV.tech Solutions connects applications, APIs, databases and spreadsheets to automate recurring tasks, reporting and approvals. We build the checks, exception handling and operating instructions alongside the workflow.

- New York headquarters and Ahmedabad office
- Overlap with your time zone

- Scope agreed in writing
The starting point

### Automate the hand-offs that slow your team down.

- Stop entering or moving the same information across several applications.
- Replace recurring report preparation and file handling with scheduled workflows.
- Make failed integrations and records needing review visible to the people responsible.
What we deliver

### Automation that fits the process you already run.

01

#### Workflow assessment and design

03

#### Spreadsheet and reporting automation

04

Explore our expertiseTime zones, team and engagement costsOutsourcing by region
Before we begin

### Common questions about workflow automation consulting

Not answered here? Ask us directly or read the full FAQ.

**Can you automate a workflow across several tools?**
Yes, when the tools provide suitable authorized access. We review available APIs, webhooks, exports and authentication before estimating the integration. Source limits and downstream permissions shape what can be automated reliably.

**Does every automation need AI?**
No. A scheduled job or API integration may be enough for a predictable process. AI is useful when a step requires language or document interpretation, and that step still needs suitable evaluation and review.

**How do you avoid duplicate records or repeated actions?**
The workflow can include stable record identifiers, state tracking, reconciliation and checks before writing. The exact design depends on whether the connected systems support safe retries and how costly a repeated action would be.

**Can you maintain automations built by another developer?**
Yes. An initial review can establish the code, schedules, dependencies, access requirements and failure history. We can then scope a repair, documentation or ongoing support engagement.

**How much does workflow automation consulting cost?**
Pricing is agreed per engagement and we quote after a scoping call. A useful first project is one recurring handoff with a clear input and output, such as preparing a weekly report from several systems or reconciling two ledgers. The estimate depends on the APIs, webhooks, exports and authentication the connected tools provide, since source limits and downstream permissions shape what can be automated reliably.

**How do you reconcile finance data across two systems?**
We start by documenting what people check today, including the exceptions and the adjustments they make by hand. The workflow then applies matching, tolerance rules, duplicate prevention and retries before any data is written or a downstream action is triggered. Where a figure must still be adjusted manually, an override layer can record the change without altering the immutable source record, which leaves an audit trail instead of an argument.

**Can you automate publishing short videos to several channels?**
Yes. Social Media Automation starts with a link to a clip you own or have permission to publish. AI drafts captions, and the workflow adds subtitles and branding. Clips that pass its quality checks publish automatically to the channels you select. An editor can change the preview or review a flagged clip. Each channel has its own publishing receipt. If an upload times out, the editor checks the channel before retrying.

Business solutions

## Connect technology to the way your business works.

MV.tech Solutions develops systems for reporting, operations, products and blockchain data. These solution areas show the work we can scope with your team; the final design depends on your processes, data and users.

Finance and reporting

### A shared reporting foundation for business decisions.

#### Finance and performance reporting

Bring financial and operational data into a warehouse, define reporting rules and develop dashboards with source reconciliation.

#### Reporting modernization

Bring a recurring spreadsheet or a Tableau or Power BI dashboard. We can rebuild the preparation behind it and compare the figures using the filters your team already trusts.

#### Metric and data consistency

Trace differences between systems, define shared KPIs and build checks for the figures used in management reporting. See how Marketing Attribution matches leads to sales.

Operations

### Applications and automation for everyday work.

#### Social Media Automation

Start with a link to a clip you have permission to publish. The tool adds AI captions, subtitles and branding. Clips that pass the quality checks publish automatically to your channels. An editor can revise a flagged clip or check a channel’s receipt.

Automate collection, validation and recurring reports. Our Email Automation project turns rows in a campaign spreadsheet into drafts for review.

Products and engineering

### Software features, AI integrations and delivery capacity.

#### Customer and partner portals

Give users an application for information, submissions and status tracking, connected to the systems that hold the records.

An AI assistant uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to read only reports the signed-in person can open. We can build around one of your existing Tableau or Power BI reports and check the answers against the figures your team trusts.

Compare on-chain activity with internal records and maintain a documented correction layer over the original data.

## Software, Data, AI & Marketing Projects

We use our publishing and email tools in our own work. The Business Intelligence Platform demo illustrates an approach from our founder’s reporting work. Other examples include a Snowflake migration for sales and inventory reporting.

Social Media Automation Business Intelligence Platform Email Automation Marketing Attribution Finance Reconciliation Campaign Content AI Usage Reporting Data Warehouse Migration Blockchain Analytics Language Model Evaluation Production Data Pipelines

### Social Media Automation

Paste a link to a video you own or have permission to use and choose your channels. AI reads the original caption when available and transcribes the speech to draft subtitles and post captions. The platform formats the clip for vertical video and fits your branding around faces and on-screen text. An editor can preview and change the result.

Clips that pass the checks can publish automatically to the selected channels, including Instagram, Facebook, Threads and YouTube. A clip flagged for review waits for an editor. Each platform’s receipt stays with the clip. If an upload times out, the editor can check whether it landed before anyone sends another copy.

Automate your publishing workflowWorkflow automation services

### Business Intelligence Platform

If someone on your team looks up the same figure in Tableau or Power BI every week, we can design an AI assistant around that report. The Business Intelligence Platform demo shows how the Model Context Protocol (MCP) can give an AI assistant read-only access to reports the signed-in person can open. The example draws on our founder’s reporting work.

Take “What were sales by region last quarter?” The assistant can find the relevant report, calculate totals across all matching records and show when the data last refreshed. Someone checking a figure can inspect the underlying rows and the reporting rules behind it.

Discuss an AI assistant for your reportsExplore MCP and AI connectorsBusiness intelligence services

### Email Automation

Our email tool turns a campaign contact list into drafts in the right mailbox. It checks the sender and recipient, keeps approved wording and flags incomplete entries. Running a batch again reuses existing drafts. The sender reviews the messages and decides when to send them.

Discuss an email workflowCustom software services

### Marketing Attribution

Which campaign leads became customers? Our founder compared an internal attribution report with an external provider’s results. He traced which records each method linked to the same sale and identified where the two disagreed. A similar review can start with one campaign and a closed sales period.

Discuss marketing attributionData engineering services

### Finance Reconciliation

Our founder built a finance integration that kept transaction detail alongside monthly balances. A reviewer could compare an account total with the ledger for the same period and investigate differences before relying on a dashboard.

Our supplier-statement guide shows how that investigation works when a credit arrives on the last day of the month and is posted the following day.

### Campaign Content

For a seasonal campaign, we designed a social carousel and delivered the individual slides alongside a preview in reading order. The editor could approve the whole story or ask for a change to a single slide. For a separate email campaign, we wrote the subject line, inbox preview and message together.

Plan content for your next campaignSee the publishing tool

### AI Usage Reporting

Did usage dip, or is a day missing? Our founder worked on a live dashboard that shows which dates an AI tool’s usage records cover. It flags incomplete periods so a team comparing two weeks can see whether it has the data to draw a conclusion.

Discuss an AI usage dashboardReporting automation services

### Data Warehouse Migration

Our founder traced the joins, filters and calculations behind legacy sales and inventory reports. He built reusable SQL views in Snowflake and checked which calculations Power BI still performed in the reports themselves.

To check the migration, he compared record counts, date ranges and reported totals with the source systems. When a figure differed, the field mappings showed where to look, from a missing source record to a filter in the report.

Discuss your first report migrationRead the reporting migration guideData warehouse migration services

### Blockchain Analytics

Our founder built a BigQuery ledger that brought transactions from several public blockchains together. It tracked assets received and sent, network fees and transfers between chains. Exchange rates let the finance team compare wallet flows in US dollars.

If the team needed to change how a transaction was classified, it could record a correction in the reporting layer. Reviewers could still trace the figures back to the original transaction.

Discuss a multi-chain ledgerBlockchain data analytics services

### Language Model Evaluation

In a model evaluation role, our founder wrote Python tasks using spreadsheets, PDFs and web pages. Some called for extracting specific fields. Others asked for a summary or an analysis of the data.

He compared answers from different models, checked whether each answer was accurate and followed the instructions, and corrected errors for use in evaluation and training.

Discuss a model evaluationRead how to evaluate a knowledge assistant

### Production Data Pipelines

Our founder ran change data capture pipelines that copied changes from operational databases into Amazon Redshift. He investigated interruptions in replication, including failures after the structure of a source table changed.

He also kept scheduled reports running, restored refreshes after outages and set up alerts for incomplete loads. He documented how to reload the affected date range and what the next person on call should check.
